questions.title: Coffee Bean Roast
questions.prompt:
Create a class `CoffeeBean` in `CoffeeBean.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String origin`, `String roastLevel`, `int acidityScore`, `double bagPrice`.
* **Constructor 1:** `CoffeeBean(String origin, String roastLevel, int acidityScore, double bagPrice)`.
* **Constructor 2:** `CoffeeBean(String origin, String roastLevel)` which sets `acidityScore = 5` and `bagPrice = 14.99`.
* **Getters and Setters:** For all four fields.
  * In `setAcidityScore(int score)`: Must be between 1 and 10 inclusive. If `< 1`, set to `1`. If `> 10`, set to `10`.
  * In `setBagPrice(double price)`: If `price < 0.0`, set to `0.0`.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: 2-arg constructor defaults; acidity upper clamp (15 -> 10); negative price clamp (-3.0 -> 0.0).

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Acidity Lower Clamp)
tests.description: setAcidityScore(0) and setAcidityScore(-4) clamp to 1.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Acidity Exact Limits)
tests.description: Setting 1 and 10 preserved.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Full Constructor)
tests.description: All 4 parameters set directly.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Zero Price)
tests.description: setBagPrice(0.0) accepts 0.0.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Origin and Roast Strings)
tests.description: Setters update strings properly.

questions.title: Weather Station Snapshot
questions.prompt:
Create a class `WeatherReport` in `WeatherReport.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String stationCode`, `double temperatureC`, `int humidityPercent`.
* **Constructor:** `WeatherReport(String stationCode, double temperatureC, int humidityPercent)`.
* **`toString()`:** Return:
  ```
  Station: <stationCode>
  Temp: <temperatureC formatted to 2 decimal places> C
  Humidity: <humidityPercent>%
  ```
  *(Separated by `\n` with no trailing newline)*
* **`equals(Object o)`:** Two weather reports are equal if their `stationCode` matches **ignoring case** AND their `humidityPercent` matches. Return `false` if `o` is `null` or not a `WeatherReport`.

Station: kord
Temp: 21.54 C
Humidity: 65%
Equal: true

questions.title: Storage Vault Allocation
questions.prompt:
Create a checked exception `StorageQuotaExceededException` in `StorageQuotaExceededException.java` that extends `Exception` with a constructor taking `String message`.

In `CloudStorage.java`, implement:
`public static int allocateSpace(int currentUsedGB, int fileGB, int totalCapacityGB) throws StorageQuotaExceededException`
* If `fileGB <= 0`, throw `IllegalArgumentException` with message: `"File size must be positive"`.
* If `currentUsedGB + fileGB > totalCapacityGB`, throw `StorageQuotaExceededException` with message:
  `"Quota exceeded: required <currentUsedGB + fileGB>GB, capacity is <totalCapacityGB>GB"`.
* Otherwise, return `currentUsedGB + fileGB`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Used: 95GB
Quota exceeded: required 105GB, capacity is 100GB

tests.description: Valid allocation followed by StorageQuotaExceededException.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Exact Capacity Allocation)
tests.description: currentUsedGB + fileGB == totalCapacityGB returns totalCapacityGB.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Zero File Size)
tests.description: fileGB = 0 throws IllegalArgumentException.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Negative File Size)
tests.description: fileGB = -5 throws IllegalArgumentException.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Checked Exception Verification)
tests.description: Verifies StorageQuotaExceededException extends Exception.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Starting Completely Full)
tests.description: Allocating 1GB when currentUsedGB == totalCapacityGB throws exception.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:

Quota exceeded: required 105GB, capacity is 100GB

questions.title: Fitness Trackable
questions.prompt:
Create an interface `TrackableActivity` in `TrackableActivity.java`:
* Abstract method: `int getDurationMinutes();`
* Abstract method: `double getCaloriesPerMinute();`
* Default method: `default double calculateTotalCalories()`: returns `getDurationMinutes() * getCaloriesPerMinute()`.
* Default method: `default boolean reachedGoal(double goalCalories)`: returns `true` if `calculateTotalCalories() >= goalCalories`, else `false`.

Create a class `Running` in `Running.java` implementing `TrackableActivity`:
* **Private fields:** `int duration`, `double paceSpeedMPH`.
* **Constructor:** `Running(int duration, double paceSpeedMPH)`.
* Implement `getDurationMinutes()` returning `duration`.
* Implement `getCaloriesPerMinute()`:
  * If `paceSpeedMPH >= 8.0`, burns `15.0` cal/min.
  * If `paceSpeedMPH >= 5.0`, burns `10.0` cal/min.
  * Otherwise burns `6.0` cal/min.

Calories: 300.0
Goal 250 cal: true
Goal 350 cal: false

questions.title: Amusement Park Ticket Hierarchy
questions.prompt:
Create a class `ParkPass` in `ParkPass.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String visitorName`, `double baseAdmission`.
* **Constructor:** `ParkPass(String visitorName, double baseAdmission)`.
* Method `calculateTotalCost()` returning `baseAdmission`.

Create subclass `VIPPass` in `VIPPass.java` extending `ParkPass`:
* **Private fields:** `boolean fastPassIncluded`, `int mealVouchers`.
* **Constructor:** `VIPPass(String visitorName, double baseAdmission, boolean fastPassIncluded, int mealVouchers)` calling `super`.
* Override `calculateTotalCost()`:
  * Start with `baseAdmission`.
  * If `fastPassIncluded` is `true`, add `$50.00`.
  * Add `$15.00` per meal voucher (`mealVouchers * 15.0`).
  * If `mealVouchers >= 3`, apply a combo discount: deduct `$10.00` from final total.

questions.title: Academic Course Enrollments
questions.prompt:
Given base class `Course` with method `int getEnrollment()` and subclass `LabCourse` (which has additional lab section students added to `getEnrollment()`), implement `EnrollmentManager.java`:
* `public static int totalEnrolled(Course[] catalog)`:
  * Sums `getEnrollment()` for all courses in array.
  * If `catalog` is `null` or empty, return `0`.
  * Skip any `null` elements safely.
* `public static int countFullCourses(Course[] catalog, int capacityLimit)`:
  * Returns count of non-null courses where `getEnrollment() >= capacityLimit`.
  * If `catalog` is `null`, return `0`.

*(The autograder provides `Course` and `LabCourse`.)*

questions.title: Bank Account Statement Parser
questions.prompt:
In `StatementReader.java`, write:
`public static double computeNetCashFlow(String filename) throws FileNotFoundException`
* The file contains transactions per line: `TransactionID,Type,Amount`
  Example: `TX1001,DEPOSIT,250.50` or `TX1002,WITHDRAWAL,75.25`
* First line is a header (`ID,Type,Amount`) and must be skipped.
* For type `"DEPOSIT"`, add the amount to net cash flow.
* For type `"WITHDRAWAL"`, subtract the amount from net cash flow.
* Any other type should be ignored.
* If the file has no data rows, return `0.0`.
* If the file is missing, throw `FileNotFoundException`. Ensure file stream is closed.

questions.title: Cloud Compute Hierarchy
questions.prompt:
Create abstract class `CloudInstance` in `CloudInstance.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String instanceId`, `double baseHourlyRate`.
* **Constructor:** `CloudInstance(String instanceId, double baseHourlyRate)`.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract double computeCost(double hoursRunning);`

Create subclass `OnDemandInstance` in `OnDemandInstance.java`:
* **Constructor:** `OnDemandInstance(String instanceId, double baseHourlyRate)`.
* Formula: `baseHourlyRate * hoursRunning`.

Create subclass `SpotInstance` in `SpotInstance.java`:
* **Private field:** `double bidDiscountPercent`. (e.g. 60.0 for 60% off).
* **Constructor:** `SpotInstance(String instanceId, double baseHourlyRate, double bidDiscountPercent)` using `super`.
* Formula:
  * Discounted rate: `effectiveRate = baseHourlyRate * (1.0 - (bidDiscountPercent / 100.0))`.
  * If `hoursRunning > 24.0`, add an interruption risk rebate: subtract `$2.00` from total cost (cost cannot drop below `0.0`).
  * Otherwise total cost is `effectiveRate * hoursRunning`.

questions.title: Smart Greenhouse Climate Loop
questions.prompt:
Simulate automated greenhouse temperature control in `GreenhouseControl.java`. Greenhouse starts at `Temp: 70` F with `Water Reserve: 50` gal.

Each round: print `Temp: <temp>F | Water: <water> gal`, display menu:
`1) Vent Air (-3F)  2) Mist Plants (-5F, -10 gal)  3) Heat Lamps (+6F)  4) Seal Greenhouse & Exit`
* `1`: Vent Air: Temp decreases by 3F.
* `2`: Mist Plants: If Water Reserve < 10 gal, print `Cannot mist: water reserve empty!`. Otherwise, deduct 10 gal from reserve and decrease temp by 5F.
* `3`: Heat Lamps: Temp increases by 6F.
* `4`: Print `Greenhouse stabilized at <temp>F with <water> gal water.` and terminate.
* **Any other input:** Print `Invalid operation. System idling.`
* **Safety Thresholds:**
  * If Temp drops to `45F` or below at any point, immediately print `EMERGENCY: Freeze alert! Crop failure.` and terminate.
  * If Temp reaches `95F` or higher at any point, immediately print `EMERGENCY: Heatwave alert! Crop scorched.` and terminate.

Read menu choices from standard input with a `Scanner`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Temp: 70F | Water: 50 gal
1) Vent Air (-3F)  2) Mist Plants (-5F, -10 gal)  3) Heat Lamps (+6F)  4) Seal Greenhouse & Exit
Temp: 76F | Water: 50 gal
1) Vent Air (-3F)  2) Mist Plants (-5F, -10 gal)  3) Heat Lamps (+6F)  4) Seal Greenhouse & Exit
Temp: 71F | Water: 40 gal
1) Vent Air (-3F)  2) Mist Plants (-5F, -10 gal)  3) Heat Lamps (+6F)  4) Seal Greenhouse & Exit
Temp: 68F | Water: 40 gal
1) Vent Air (-3F)  2) Mist Plants (-5F, -10 gal)  3) Heat Lamps (+6F)  4) Seal Greenhouse & Exit
Greenhouse stabilized at 68F with 40 gal water.
